result.question: Quantas internações tiveram tanto diagnóstico principal quanto secundário?
result.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS com_ambos_diagnosticos FROM internacoes WHERE "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL AND "DIAG_SECUN" IS NOT NULL;
result.generated_sql: SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" JOIN cid c2 ON i."DIAG_SECUN" = c2."CID" WHERE i."DIAG_SECUN" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c."CD_DESCRICAO" ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1;
